scene.note: You look around the shop folder from the terminal and write what you find in notes.txt.

steps.note: Idris wants to know where on the laptop the shop folder is.
The shell is always inside one folder. When the terminal opens, it is the shop folder.
The terminal prints that folder's full path on one line, from the top of the computer down.
That whole line goes after here: in the notes.
One drawing keeps filling the memory stick, and Idris wants to know which.
A long listing of artwork shows one line per file, with its size in bytes.
You compare the size column from top to bottom and find the largest number.
That file's name, exactly as listed, goes after biggest: in the notes.
Sol left a handover note in desk, but Idris cannot see it.
A plain listing of desk leaves out every name that starts with a dot.
Asking for all names shows the hidden ones too, beside the two that every folder has.
The hidden note's full name, dot included, goes after hidden: in the notes.
